tasks.title: E06 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E06 (Personal and station cameras). Implement it in full from its product brief docs/product/tdd/E06.md and docs/SYSTEM.md (its module, ports and seams; this epic has no design): every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E06/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E06/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10). workers/camera/src/crew_health_camera/analyzers/compression_rate/ and workers/camera/tests/compression_rate/ belong to E30: do not edit them.

ticket_tasks.title: Build the authenticated camera acquisition worker
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, in that order, then all reads. This is an E06 implementation brief for a fresh session. No docs/tdd/E06.md, docs/requests/E06.md or E06 design reviews existed when planned; do not create a design or treat another epic's pending proposals as contracts. Implement the product brief E06-01/02/03, not a fictional design. PLAN.md Design decisions and Design deviations give the binding implementation settlements. Work only in owned_paths, recheck existence and every current docs/build/*/tasks.json plus design ownership before editing, and return any unowned fix to its owner. No git, no product/configuration/schema/root-manifest/request/AI-use-log edits outside ownership. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen used as a dash.

C1 through C4 in PLAN.md are addressed to the coordinator but not yet filed in docs/requests/E06.md because the planning edit restriction forbids it. Require the coordinator to publish/dispose them before implementing affected shared boundaries. C1 must ratify the exact conventional source/member/scenario reservations because there is no E06 design section 13. C2 must publish trusted pairing, physical start/cancel/status/result receipts and generated time/quantity/settings codecs, consolidating R-E01-17/R-E02-8/R-E05-2/3/4/6. C3 must publish sourced camera policy/configuration/schema paths and finite SettingSpec descriptors, consolidating R-E01-1/R-E05-5; no clinical quality parameter is guessed. C4 must publish the executable real-stack/fault/evidence/gate handoffs. Missing signatures, bounds, commands, generated artifacts or proofs block that work and acceptance, never become a local substitute or an optimistic pass. No requests are implicitly approved by this brief.

SYSTEM 5.1 supplies IdFactory/require_id and schema-pattern identities; 5.2 Clock/TimeInput/NormalizedTime/ClockSegments/ClockCorrections and process epochs; 5.3 MissionClock; 5.4 finite Decimal Quantity/Unit and WireQuantity/WireUnitConverter; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope on HTTP; 5.6 ReleaseHandle/ConfigReleaseReader/ConfigReader and validated immutable pins; 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot/StoredEvent and audience/atomic replication rules; 5.8 CommandIdentity/IdempotencyStore/AcceptedReceipt/ResultVisibility and mission-life full operation/target/parameters/body identity; 5.9 AuditEntry/AuditVerifier covering every stored field; 5.10 HealthState/ElapsedDeadline/AbsoluteDeadline, 5.10.1 TaskQueue/TaskRunner/TaskHandler generations, 5.10.2 typed evaluation isolation; 5.11 HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry and create_app(settings) assembly. Consume these mechanisms in their owning hub providers, not a local E06 transaction, retry queue, ledger, clock, scheduler, evaluator-isolation wrapper or supervisor. Workers exchange generated contract models over authenticated HTTP and never import hub implementation (SYSTEM 6.2). C2 must resolve pure-kernel packaging versus generated transport before worker-side clock/quantity injection; do not copy either type. Use SYSTEM 6's uv toolchain, 7.1 raw-frame prohibition, 8.1 exact Q8 seams, 8.3 per-object/per-field privacy, 8.6 durable capture and storage-fault distinction, 8.7 reference envelopes, 9/10 dependencies and kernel.testing. Bounded kernel fakes are unit-test inputs only, never a substitute for required real-provider acceptance.

Only named existing external operations are used, never implemented here: createSession (openapi.yaml:103); recordObservation/getObservation (4411/4509); createMeasurementRequest/getMeasurementRequest/actOnMeasurementRequest/recordAttempt (4656/4758/4830/4935); getHealth (61), getConfigRelease/activateConfigRelease (811/881), openHelpSession (8464), getEvents (11218). Exact payloads are requests.schema.json $defs ObservationCreate, MeasurementRequestCreate, MeasurementRequestAction and AttemptCreate; outputs are Observation, MeasurementRequest, Capability and ErrorEnvelope from the listed schemas. The action enum is submit/accept/decline/start/cancel until an approved amendment. AttemptCreate has sequence, started_at, ended_at, outcome success/failed/rejected, failure_reason, observations and quality_notes. Observation requires patient/operator/mission identity, code, finite value with original and canonical unit provenance, observed_at/entered_at, origin_mode LIVE/REPLAY/SIM, actual acquisition_method, quality_status/rule version, nullable episode/device/supersedes and string-valued context. Preserve exact required/nullability rules; do not put structured proof into string context or treat quality_notes as authentication. CameraSession and QualityResult are names in docs/product/tdd/E06.md:9, not published schemas. C2 must settle their representation, not an E06 shadow API.

E01 owns records_observation and observation validation; E02 owns identity/consent; E05 owns measurement_request/measurement_attempt/measurement_gap and the measurement workflow, plus its other tables in docs/tdd/E05.md section 5. Read/write them only through approved ports or public HTTP, never cross-module SQL. ObservationCommands/ObservationReader, ConsentQueries.allows, MeasurementCommands and CapabilityQueries are their owners' ports (SYSTEM 4.2); missing complete method/DTO contracts remain C2, not permission to invent overloads. E05 owns measurement_request.changed, source proof and atomic attempts/observations; E06 emits no new public event, public Job kind or safety-state mutation. A schema-valid camera value is not automatically trusted or clinically validated. Clinical policy, labels and instructions come from the accepted pinned release. Existing indicator-catalog.json supplies indicator labels/regions, ui-copy.json supplies display words, kit-map.json supplies instruments, and E30 skills-catalog.json supplies taught timing. E03/E27/E30 own those documents. D12 supplies unit-mapping.json through E01's accepted overlay. None supplies missing camera-quality thresholds; C3 supplies the approved policy artifact instead.

Write failing tests first, trace every case to the R/V/D or AGENTS invariant stated below, and property-test parsers and signal/selector decisions. Domain code has runtime typed precondition checks, bounded loops/memory, injected time/IDs, no mutable globals, no NaN/infinity/default missing values. Configuration-edit proof changes sourced non-safety content without code; independent numerical golden oracles must not derive their expected answer from the same configuration under test. No safety mapping edits or threshold tuning to make tests pass. Privacy applies to logs/errors/cache/events/exports and study artifacts. Unit/integration tests use no real devices, external network or wall clock; live hardware measurements are a separate identified evidence run. Real-stack tests use actual create_app(settings) through HTTP and real SQLite in a temporary directory or Playwright against the running composed hub, with no mocks/dependency overrides inside it. Optional external parts can be absent or their documented explicit-profile adapters. Missing accepted evidence cannot be replaced by API-example seed state, a cached previous run or a SIM result labeled LIVE.

Done means the concern below and all its gates pass with nonempty test collection, plus its required hardware evidence, CI and independent review. Report every failure/blocked clause. Scope-specific software success never implies epic or medical validation. After a bug fix, rerun the full relevant suite. The coordinator records each coder/reviewer AI-use row; do not edit AI-USE-LOG.md yourself.

T1 builds the camera acquisition worker and its own package tests/member packaging only. Ownership expands SYSTEM 4.3/6.1/6.2's workers/camera and canonical package crew_health_camera to the listed src package and member files; await C1 ratification before creation. Keep tests inside the owned package, excluded from installed production artifacts and coverage source totals. Do not claim the whole workers/camera tree: E30 section 13 reserves workers/camera/src/crew_camera/analyzers/compression_rate and workers/camera/tests/compression_rate. Do not create compatibility crew_camera modules, E30 analyzer code, hub modules/tables, UI, medical configuration, deployment assets or another scenario runner. E20 owns launch/supervision/images; provide its approved worker entry point under C1. No worker artifacts exist at planning time. T2 independently owns the study and scenario suite and must not be a source import dependency.

Implement PLAN Design decisions, product brief Required work E06-01/02, PRD section 5 camera rows and R09/R11/R29, charter 2/3/5 and SYSTEM 3/6.2. OpenCV captures on the device holding the camera. Load and validate pinned landmark/runtime assets and accepted camera-policy content before service. Compute deterministic POS and separate CHROM corroboration; respiration uses an independent torso-landmark motion/periodicity calculation. Missing shoulders can reject only respiration. Never use pulse as breathing, manufacture frames, fill a sample gap, force a spectral peak to a band boundary or silently average algorithms/views. C3 supplies source-checked formula vectors, analysis bands, sufficient-window requirements and every quality threshold before acceptance code. Implement range/saturation/stuck/rate checks without treating insufficient samples as pass. Each measured quantity crossing a boundary carries its approved unit; pulse's example wire bpm maps through D12 to /min, not a worker heuristic. Preserve the original quantities and calculation/rule/release/device/window provenance. LIVE, REPLAY and SIM traverse the same inward calculation; replay/generated inputs exist only under explicit evaluation profiles.

Explicit pairing must come from C2's authenticated E02/E05 binding, matched to subject/operator/mission/origin/release, actual camera and capture association, consent, acquisition generation and reserved sequence. Station session alone authorizes no clinical read/write. Drop unpaired/ambiguous frames before patient analysis, including multiple or lost participants. Recheck current binding on result publication; revocation or subject switch fences stale callbacks. In the explicit demo profile, real presenter data routes to the verified demo-operator and cannot alter Mara's SIM episode/baseline/participation (E02 section 3.4). No implicit face matching or biometric retention. If a separate opt-in identity experiment is supplied under C2/C4, it remains isolated evaluation, has its own consent/error/rejection results, and never authenticates a chart write. Default absent branch is truthfully unavailable, not measured accuracy.

Select a quality-qualified camera separately per indicator and window using the C3 ordering, stable actual device-ID tie breaking. Retain every available real source result, selection reason and disagreement via the approved C2 attempt/provenance representation. Views sharing lighting/algorithm are correlated sources (E30 OD2); never claim independent validation from agreement. A one-camera path works on the laptop. No sensor/ECG substitution, diagnostic reassurance, gap closure, warning mutation or completion reward arises from selection. All user-facing failure/selection words are served configuration, not runtime literals. Invalid policy rejects candidate activation with the last good version retained and each open acquisition pinned. Missing first policy keeps camera acceptance off visibly.

Worker /health, native loopback and resource/health/restart values come from SYSTEM 3, workers.camera.* in 5.11 and DEPLOYMENT 7.3. Local private health may be unauthenticated; work calls use protected per-service token, or enrolled mutual TLS remotely. Remote workers keep frames local; no frame/image upload route or raw frame file. C3 must register finite limits for frame bytes/samples/window/camera count/inflight work/results/tickets and every scan, plus resource limits before capture. Reject busy admission before capture/reserving result capacity instead of creating an unbounded queue. E05 owns durable tasks, leases, sequences, retry and cancellation; register no new public Job kind. Every external capture/library/process/HTTP call is bounded with the approved timeout. A timeout is unknown physical state, not proof of stop. Duplicate start gets the same physical receipt; post-crash uncertainty never causes a blind restart of the same measurement. These mechanics wait for C2, not a worker replacement ledger.

Successful and refused attempts go through recordAttempt as the authenticated adapter after the E05 acceptance/dispatch. E05 owns its transaction and E01 append; the worker never writes databases. Do not acknowledge/drop a captured real outcome until C2's durable evidence acknowledgment. On retryable failure retain the already captured bounded derived evidence under the approved recovery handoff, never raw frames, and resubmit the same immutable identity. Cancellation fences usable publication, but late clinical evidence remains attributed/quarantined; E30 persist=False drills retain no clinical readings. Do not implement an ad hoc durable spool to solve the missing handoff: C2 must define it. Optional E30 CameraReferencePort/ReferenceWindowRequest from E30 section 4.1 remains off until approved C2 codecs/signatures exist. E30 owns compression calculation, comparison and skill state; hosting cannot edit its reserved paths or swallow storage errors under an unavailable result.

Time follows SYSTEM 5.2/5.3/5.10 through the approved bridge: original capture endpoints/source clock/segment/correction version are retained. Sample and ticket durations, physical timeout and retry intervals are elapsed; consent expiry and a requested UTC endpoint are absolute. Within an epoch use injected monotonic time; after restart normalize the durable interval, never compare counters across epochs. Forward/backward correction, future/unknown provenance or discontinuous capture cannot make an old or insufficient window valid. Never replace observed_at with arrival. The same raw timestamp in two reset segments is a required test, not merely increasing timestamps.

Tests first inside the owned package: R09/V05 pulse-only and opposite independent failure; V06 out-of-band and boundary peaks, nonfinite/empty/short/maximum samples, gaps, motion, low light, saturation/stuck/rate failures; R11/V07 stable selector under permuted views, correlated agreement, per-indicator choice and retained conflict; R29/V08/V39 explicit pair positive, absent/ambiguous/misidentified/revoked/changed pair negative. V09/D09 partition tests keep actual method/device/origin and no SIM contamination; they do not claim LIVE hardware acceptance. D08/V23 retains movement refusal with no accepted Observation or support. AGENTS 1.1/V75 scratches non-safety explanation/label in the approved configuration and proves changed output without code, old pin retained, corrupt update rejected.

Worker-process integration tests drive the real hub via composition HTTP with real temporary SQLite. Cover E05 accept/start/attempt/readback and manual backup with worker absent; V11/13/16/35 and AGENTS 1.6 kill worker/hub before and after dispatch/capture/submit/commit/ack, duplicate callbacks and concurrent starts, cancel racing completion, retry after 24 hours, same key on different target/body, disk full and lost response. Inspect through approved read/evidence ports; verify no lost accepted record or duplicate physical start and visible unaccepted/quarantined state. Storage/I/O/integrity errors must fail loudly. V14/15 and D3 cover reset segments, unknown/future time, both clock corrections, restart and mission midnight, unit ambiguity and late older evidence never current. AGENTS 1.3/1.4/1.7 cover manual/fixed-help availability with all optional parts absent, cross-person/token/grant denial, and no raw frames/private content in HTTP/logs/files. Optional E30 bridge tests, when enabled, cover expiry/abandon/generation and persist=False without copying its engine. Property/golden tests compare independent formula vectors, not just a configured expected label.

The first four gates check the worker package and all its package tests, including its real-process integration; the import gate must inspect the actual worker import closure, not pass on an empty hub discovery. Add stricter standalone member contracts under owned pyproject.toml, permitting generated boundary imports and forbidding hub implementations, SQL, model and ground dependencies. The final existing validate_hub command is blocked until C4 extends its inventory to worker decisions and independently verifies 95% branches/full conditions/complexity/mutations as applicable. The pytest combined coverage gate is necessary but not sufficient. T1 done additionally requires the actual webcam success/refusal and one-laptop fallback evidence from the identified T2 table_min run; no passing unit suite substitutes for that join.
gates: uv run --project workers/camera pytest -c workers/camera/pyproject.toml -q workers/camera/src/crew_health_camera --cov-config=workers/camera/pyproject.toml --cov=crew_health_camera --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95
uv run --project workers/camera ruff check --config workers/camera/pyproject.toml workers/camera/src/crew_health_camera
uv run --project workers/camera ruff format --check --config workers/camera/pyproject.toml workers/camera/src/crew_health_camera
uv run --project workers/camera mypy --strict --config-file workers/camera/pyproject.toml workers/camera/src/crew_health_camera
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py interfaces generated trace safety mutations

T2 owns only eval/scenarios/E06/ for E06 real-stack acceptance, explicit-profile test inputs, frozen camera protocol and reproducible pseudonymized quality evidence. This is SYSTEM 4.3/6.1's per-epic scenario reservation, pending C1 ratification. Keep evaluation-only analysis in this folder, not a new production package or shared framework. T1 owns worker algorithms/member packaging and its package tests. E21 owns eval/runner, eval/scenarios/conftest.py, registry, fixtures/demo-mara-fd19 and How we know panel; E20 owns reference deployment/combined-load artifacts. Do not edit those paths, root tooling, E30 study/analyzer or any product implementation. Reuse their approved launch/client/seed/observer/Playwright contracts under C4, not another launcher, seed engine, test-only branch or hub override. Author protocol/oracles/scenarios concurrently with T1; no import of its source. Final execution requires its running real worker plus real E01/E02/E05 composition. depends_on is empty for source authoring, not permission to pass runtime gates before the worker exists.

Implement PLAN End-to-end evidence table in full; product brief E06-03, VALIDATION sections 2/3/6, PRD R09/R11/R29 and the camera R46 contribution. The brief owns E06-01/02/03 and core V05/06/07/08/09/39, D08/09. Keep added critical-path/contributor scenarios with their exact source clauses. E01/E02/E05 hard providers must be their real instances through create_app(settings), real SQLite in a temporary directory and normal generated HTTP operations. No internal mocks, monkeypatching services or direct table inserts. Only documented external adapters/fault hooks can vary capture/input; explicit SIM/REPLAY remains labeled. Browser cases use E21's Python Playwright against the real E03/E05 app and normal accessible controls, no mocked HTTP. Inputs are configuration-derived or independently source-checked numerical fixtures under this explicit eval profile, never clinical values typed to force a pass or illustrative completed API resources seeded as state.

Write HTTP/worker scenarios first with these traces. R09/V05: accepted pulse when shoulders missing, separate refused respiration with exact configured reason, retained observation only for pulse; also opposite pipeline failure. V06: outside configured band, too-short/empty/gappy/saturated/stuck/rapidly-changing/nonfinite input refuses without clipped reassurance. R11/V07: qualified views disagree; read back each source, actual device, selected source/rationale and conflict before/after restart/events; one-webcam positive control remains sufficient T0. R29/V08/V39: unpaired/ambiguous/uncertain or misidentified experiment binding, wrong device/adapter/subject, expired/revoked consent, old generation and station-only token all create no patient reading; valid explicit pairing is positive. An absent optional face recognizer has not-measured error evidence, never a claimed successful misidentification study.

V09/V47/D09: with Mara displayed, route a genuine LIVE presenter capture to explicit demo-operator with actual source/method/selector/disagreement; preserve Mara's SIM baseline/streak/crew goal. CI's labeled adapter variant proves partition mechanics only. D09 specifically requires actual agreeing camera views at table_min and LIVE source; one webcam proves T0 only, not the agreeing-view clause. D08/V23: first movement failure persists with configured reason, no value or accepted observation/support; subsequent real capture does not erase first failure. Drive episode timeline/support counterparts through real E15/E12/E13 when installed; do not mock a successful counterparty. Missing mandatory D clauses keep full acceptance open. No fixed expected pulse value or required manual-camera agreement is invented.

V11/V13/V16/V35 and AGENTS durability: absent/unplugged worker, busy bound, cancel before/during/after capture, late quarantined evidence, duplicate/retried dispatch and sequence, wrong-target idempotency reuse, concurrent clients, hub/worker death before/after capture/ingest/commit/ack and disk full. Assert one logical accepted record/physical receipt, intact audit/ledger/outbox through approved E01 evidence interfaces, current replay authorization, visible unsaved/pending/reconciliation and manual fallback. Retrying after a day cannot remeasure. Physical unknown cannot become stopped or completed. Real late input is retained until durable handoff; no raw video spool. Use owner-supplied deterministic fault hooks instead of another recovery implementation.

V14/V15, D3/D12, AGENTS time/units: same raw timestamp in two source-clock reset segments, correction forward/backward, restart/new epoch, future/unmapped interval, old reading delivered now, mission midnight and incompatible units. Original observed_at/unit/origin remain; only proven capture time can be fresh. V75/AGENTS configuration: activate a sourced non-safety explanation/label edit through real release ETag flow and see changed API/UI without rebuilding, while an open acquisition keeps its pin; malformed candidate retains last good, missing initial policy is unavailable. Never change safety mappings. AGENTS privacy: cross-person/grant/token denial across get/read/event/replay and actual active caches/log/evidence exits; no private text/frames/face templates in public artifacts. No ground grant from link availability or officer grant from role alone.

V01/V69, charter 6 and AGENTS safety: stop camera/model/device/ground providers, keep direct E01 manual pulse/breathing capture and real fixed help usable, including verified-officer capture for an incapacitated subject without a new patient consent dependency. Through real UI show separate not-measured reason and manual path; help entry stays <=500 ms during acquisition/load/recovery using E20 hooks and complete E21 no-model-call observer. Observations/camera selection cannot alter warning authority or reward participation; no unsafe model action starts capture. Compare ordinary capture with model absent and ground unavailable without importing forbidden ground-link readers. Existing source-independent warnings are not cleared by capture failure or config activation. E20/E21 own the complete mission-day/load/reference report, but supply the real E06 fallback and contention evidence rather than a fabricated replacement suite.

When the optional real E30 bridge is enabled under C2, exercise V85/86/87 over its public HTTP: agree retains both sources, disagree retains manual and every camera Observation plus retry/incomplete step, no-reference retains unchecked manual count excluded from support; no gap closure/diagnosis/skill success on disagreement and no clinical drill retention. E30 owns comparison/plan/skill/drill semantics. No E06 core gate depends on this absent optional provider. Record its clauses as not selected with documented optional-provider precondition, not passed or silently skipped. If selected, missing/failed clauses make the run fail. Do not use E30's obsolete discard-on-disagreement or late-result-disposal semantics.

Freeze the venue study protocol and hashes before the first consenting adult team volunteer (Part A Q5/Q6/Q8, SYSTEM 8.1; VALIDATION 6). C4 supplies owner-approved consent text/configuration, withdrawal/deletion and publication policy, exact result schemas and input/output paths within this ownership. Do not collect real participant data or publish identifiers without those concrete approvals. No raw frames are retained or sent. Use pseudonymized derived windows and the same real production pipelines. Freeze participant-level development versus held-out sets, releases/algorithm/gate versions and exclusions before looking at held-out errors. No window from one person's development data enters their held-out test set. Repeated windows are not independent people. Missing held-out participants is not measured, never a fake pass.
